issues.detail: The Hebrew text addresses 'Elohim' (אֱלֹהִים), but the Vietnamese renders it as 'Đức Giê-hô-va' (Yahweh/Jehovah), swapping the divine name.
The Hebrew superscription 'לַמְנַצֵּחַ עַל נְגִינַת לְדָוִד' (For the leader, on stringed instruments, of David) is entirely omitted in the Vietnamese.
